Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_enable_key_desc: Set the hotkey to enable or disable the aimbot function.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_part_desc: Select the body part for the aimbot to lock onto.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_change_part_key: Use the hotkey to quickly switch between different target body parts.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_max_distance_de: The maximum distance for the aimbot to work. Targets beyond this distance will be ignored.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_show_fov_desc: Draw a circle on the screen displaying the current aimbot detection range.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_fov_radius_desc: Adjust the size of the aimbot detection range circle.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_show_target_lin: Draw a line between the center of the screen and the locked target.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_target_update_r: The frequency at which the aimbot logic searches for or switches targets (higher value = faster updates).
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_super_magic_bul: When enabled, bullets will spawn directly above the enemy's head.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_magic_bullet_sp: Adjust the flight speed or acceleration of magic bullets when tracking targets.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_disable_recoil_: Completely remove weapon recoil when firing.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_low_recoil_desc: Reduce the recoil to a specified multiplier instead of completely eliminating it.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_aimbot_low_recoil_rate: Adjust the specific recoil multiplier (0.0 to 1.0).
Translate.cfg_global_module_uni_gui_enable_desc: Master switch to enable or disable global drawing and visual module logic.
Translate.cfg_global_module_uni_gui_enable_key_des: Set the hotkey to quickly show or hide all global drawing overlays.
Translate.cfg_global_module_mute_notice_enable_des: When enabled, notification popups will be muted during hotkey feature toggles.
Translate.cfg_global_module_overlay_fps_limit_enab: Limit the maximum rendering frames of the overlay to reduce GPU overhead and improve game FPS.
Translate.cfg_global_module_overlay_enable_desc: Enable the native overlay rendering layer on top of the game screen.
Translate.cfg_global_module_screen_crosshair_enabl: Enable or disable rendering a custom assistive crosshair at the center of the screen.
Translate.cfg_global_module_choose_screen_crosshai: Choose your preferred crosshair style from the list of loaded crosshair images.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_flash_key_desc: Set the hotkey to trigger the instant teleportation (flash) function.
Translate.cfg_combat_module_flash_distance_desc: Adjust the teleportation distance per flash trigger (in meters).
